review: Whole coach and coupling fit within frame; class-specific windows and underfloor detail visible.
Curtain folds, quilt seams, berth framing, panel, table and mirror remain intact and legible; fine Monte Carlo grain remains.
Square-window 2A arrangement is distinct from first AC; full body/buffers framed, underfloor gear and entrance detail visible; fine grain remains.

Two-tier berth arrangement, upper safety rails, ladders, lower support bases, curtains, reading lights, table and bottle holders read clearly. Fine Monte Carlo grain remains, especially in shadow; no denoising used.
Broad rectangular three-tier sealed windows distinguish this class. Full exterior and coupler framing preserved; class markings and underfloor equipment readable. Fine Monte Carlo grain remains.

Day-mode three-tier bay shows folded middle-berth backrests, support chains, ladders, upper guards and broad window. Table, bottle holders and wall reading lights remain legible. Fine Monte Carlo grain persists, no denoising.

Non-AC barred windows, varied louvred shutters and low roof vents distinguish the second-sitting branch. Interior seats visible through open windows; full coach and coupling fit in frame. Fine grain remains.

Individual 3+3 second-sitting seats, open luggage racks, barred shutters and paired ceiling fans read clearly. Aisle remains open, class topology distinct from GS benches. Fine grain remains without denoising.
Chair-car class signage and sealed-window AC branch remain legible; full body, buffers, coupling, steps and underfloor gear are contained in frame. Fine grain remains without denoising.
High-backed 3+2 chair-car seating with separate armrests and linen headrest covers reads clearly. Curtains, racks, overhead fans and open aisle visible. Fine grain remains without denoising.
